messages.subject: Running 1st simple RHIPE example (rhlapply)

0.51 User Doc .pdf), every thing works well up until I execute the
statement

> r <- rhlapply(1000000, fun=nbrmean, ofolder="/test/one",
mapred=mapred)

This statement causes the following error message:

Error in rhlapply(1e+06, fun = nbrmean, ofolder = "/tmp/
one", mapred = mapred) :
object 'clear' not found

Any idea what causes this error message when i execute this rhlapply
() statement?
